title: THE REGISTRY — the organism's rows (rung S10)
_owner: scripts/registry.mjs (SOLE WRITER; every other organ reads through its exported readers or its CLI)
_why: Every un-nailed literal in the organism moved into this file as ROWS. A row that cannot be checked validates nothing (spec §6's witness law), so the shape of a row is the shape of the organism's own memory.

tables.description: the CLOSED table set — registry.mjs TABLES is the authority; this pins that each table is an array of row objects

items.description: a row is identified by subject (or id, for the rulings lane) and carries the stamps its owner writes

consumers.description: R1's DECLARED SET — each consumer is a named organ or HIM

appenders.description: R1's MANY-ONE shape — >= 2 unique organ names on a lane whose SCHEMA belongs to schema_owner

born_red.description: F-1's DECLARED red — a red with no reason is a mood, not a measurement
